api_db.title: API + Database
api_db.intro: Use the provider HTTPS API with credentials stored encrypted in the database.

steps.title: Open {{provider}} dashboard
paragraphs: Create or copy an API key (or token) from your {{provider}} account with permission to send mail.

steps.title: Paste in Database mode
paragraphs: Choose API delivery and Credential Storage: Database, then enter keys and save.

api_wp_config.title: API + wp-config.php
api_wp_config.intro: Keep API secrets out of the database by defining BOOLEANSMTP_* constants in wp-config.php.

steps.title: Copy constants from the form
paragraphs: Switch to WP Config mode and copy the generated define() lines into wp-config.php.

steps.title: Save connection
paragraphs: Confirm the acknowledgement checkbox, then register the connection.

smtp_db.title: SMTP + Database
smtp_db.intro: Use SMTP with host/port and credentials stored in the database.

steps.title: SMTP credentials
paragraphs: From {{provider}}, copy SMTP host, port, encryption, username, and password (or app password).

steps.title: Database mode
paragraphs: Choose SMTP delivery and Credential Storage: Database, then fill host/preset and credentials.

smtp_wp_config.title: SMTP + wp-config.php
smtp_wp_config.intro: Define SMTP settings as constants; sensitive values are not stored in the DB.

steps.title: Add defines to wp-config.php
paragraphs: Copy the generated constants block and adjust values to match your SMTP endpoint.

steps.title: Register
paragraphs: Use WP Config storage, confirm the checkbox, and save.
